title: Shadow canary certification for low-precision variants + cascade pinflow
creator: Asha Patel
description: We need a robust, low-friction certification path for INT8/GPTQ/AWQ/FP8 variants that validates production safety and performance without blocking fast rollouts. This ticket implements a "shadow canary" flow that runs quantized variants in parallel to production (non-serving shadow traffic + synthetic golden prompts) and wires their regression signals into a cascade pin propagation system so stable variants can be auto-promoted to a pin registry or flagged for rollback. The goal is to catch quality regressions (latency, token-level loss, hallucination rate, structured-output contract violations) earlier while preserving SLOs for latency and cost.
acceptance_criteria: Shadow canary harness deployed to staging and able to run at production-like QPS with preserved KV-cache behavior
Golden prompt corpus (seeded + fuzzed) defined and stored; automated daily run produces baseline scorecard

Telemetry pipeline emits pairwise metrics (baseline vs variant) for latency50/95/99, p99 tail token generation time, normalized perplexity, hallucination signal, and structured-output parsing failures
Cascade pinflow rules implemented: stable -> candidate -> pinned with manual approval gates and automated rollback triggers
Dashboard and alerting configured: regression alert thresholds and playbook links visible in Console
Canary-to-pin propagation documented and tested end-to-end via synthetic regression injection and verified rollback flow
steps: Create golden prompt set (300 prompts): 60 structured-output, 120 conversational, 60 code, 60 long-context stress prompts
Implement shadow runner that duplicates requests (headers & routing) to quant variant instances while returning baseline responses to callers
Ensure KV-cache equivalence by replaying cached prefixes to variant runtime; instrument mismatches as a metric
Hook telemetry: extend existing ingest to accept pair identifiers and compute delta metrics per-request and aggregated per-cycle
Build cascade pinflow state machine in the pin service: candidate -> canary -> promoted/pinned or rollback
Integrate manual review UI in Console for final pin approval with diffs and example inputs
Create synthetic regression injection harness to simulate degradation and validate alerts/rollback

decisions: Run shadow canaries in 'no-return' mode: production continues to serve baseline responses; shadow is purely observational to avoid customer impact
Use a hybrid golden prompts approach: seeded real customer prompts (anonymized) + synthetically fuzzed prompts to expand coverage
Prioritize telemetry metrics over raw token-level accuracy; first-class signals will be latency delta, structured-output parse failure rate, and hallucination heuristics
Automated promotions to pinned state will require both metric stability over 48h and a manual sign-off from PM for high-impact models
Security review required because golden prompt set includes anonymized customer data; store encrypted in KMS-backed bucket
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Shadow runners increase cluster load and may affect baseline latency. Mitigation: throttle shadow QPS to a sampled percentage and apply cache-sampling to reduce KV-cache thrash.
Risk: Golden prompt set leaks PII. Mitigation: filter and anonymize pipeline + KMS bucket + limited access group.
Risk: False positives from synthetic prompts. Mitigation: separate signal channels for synthetic vs anonymized real prompts and weight real-prompt regressions higher.
Risk: Cascade pinflow complexity could block model launches. Mitigation: allow opt-out for low-risk models and provide an 'expedited' path with stricter telemetry windows

notes: This ticket is intended to complement existing quant onboarding guardrails (see ENG-31245 and ENG-40227) by providing continuous observational certification rather than a one-time ingestion gate.
We will iterate on the hallucination heuristics — current short-term proxy is named-entity contradiction and factuality classifier score delta.
If the shadow flow proves stable, next phase will include controlled small-percent traffic switching to variants behind a feature flag and observe live user impact before pin promotion.
